answer: Require each identity to escrow a 700-unit bond and serve a thirty-four epoch probation. Each round it completes one random task and gathers four endorsements from reviewers with disjoint recent partners; reused proofs, copied sentences, or same-window submissions freeze the bond for fourteen rounds. The ledger verifies signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm locks 700 units per alias and replays thirty-four rounds, while marble traces expose the cluster, relic history prevents reuse, and vertex links reveal coordinated rings.
